t: 元老院违背他的意愿选择佩尔蒂纳克接替康莫德斯为罗马皇帝.
te: The Senate chooses Pertinax against his will to succeed Commodus as Roman emperor.
dz: 元老院违背他的意愿选择佩尔蒂纳克接替康莫德斯为罗马皇帝.
de: The Senate chooses Pertinax against his will to succeed Commodus as Roman emperor.

t: 在刺杀罗马皇帝佩尔蒂纳克斯后,他的普拉托里亚卫队将王位拍卖给迪迪乌斯·朱利安斯.
te: After assassinating the Roman Emperor Pertinax, his Praetorian Guards auction off the throne to Didius Julianus.
dz: 在刺杀罗马皇帝佩尔蒂纳克斯后,他的普拉托里亚卫队将王位拍卖给迪迪乌斯·朱利安斯.
de: After assassinating the Roman Emperor Pertinax, his Praetorian Guards auction off the throne to Didius Julianus.

t: 杰出的士兵Septimius Severus被军队在伊利里库姆宣布为皇帝.
te: The distinguished soldier Septimius Severus is proclaimed emperor by the army in Illyricum.
dz: 杰出的士兵Septimius Severus被军队在伊利里库姆宣布为皇帝.
de: The distinguished soldier Septimius Severus is proclaimed emperor by the army in Illyricum.

t: 罗马元老院通过动议,宣布塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁斯为皇帝,将神圣的荣誉授予珀蒂纳克斯,并判处现任皇…
te: The Roman Senate passes a motion proclaiming Septimius Severus emperor, awards divine honours to Pertinax, and sentence…
dz: 罗马元老院通过动议,宣布塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁斯为皇帝,将神圣的荣誉授予珀蒂纳克斯,并判处现任皇帝迪迪乌斯·朱利安努斯死刑.
de: The Roman Senate passes a motion proclaiming Septimius Severus emperor, awards divine honours to Pertinax, and sentences current emperor Didius Julianus to death.
